name: Suzhou Lvkon Transmission Tech Co.
summary: Suzhou Lvkon Transmission Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of power transmission systems for new energy commercial vehicles in China and internationally. The company engages in architecture design of electric drive assembly systems for new energy vehicles, control strategy, special gearbox development, high torque density, and drive motor and controller. It also engages in the design and production of components, such as gearboxes and motors. The company offers drive assembly products for use in buses, trucks, special-purpose vehicles, and off-road mobile machinery. In addition, it provides automated mechanical transmission products, drive motors for new energy vehicles, and power assembly products for battery electric and hybrid electric vehicles. Suzhou Lvkon Transmission Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is based in Suzhou, China.
